name: Roomwise
summary: A family money app where each budget is a room in a house that fills up as money is spent
about: A seven-page money app for one household that shares its money, in lemon and citrus or an olive night theme. The home screen is a drawn house: each room is a budget, like the kitchen for groceries or the garage for transport, and it fills from the floor up as the month's money is spent, glowing berry when it goes over. Bills sit on a calendar you can drag them across, and spending, family plans, contributions and settings all work, with sample data in rupees.
how: Open a page from the folder tabs: Home, Budget, Bills, Spending, Plans, Family or Settings
Tap a room in the house to see its budget, add spending or change its limit
Drag a bill to another day on the Bills calendar, or press it to pay, move, edit or delete
Add spending; the matching room fills up and warns you when it goes over
Save towards family plans from the shared pot and record who put money in
Switch the spending chart range, press Ctrl+K to jump, and reset demo data in Settings
